thread:
Raj: heads up — saw a spike of GPU preemption alerts in cluster-gamma. 5 alerts over 10m.
Olivia: saw that too, paged at 3rd alert. Oncall is me, ETA checking nodes.
Alertbot: [ALERT] gpu_panic_rate high in cluster-gamma (5m avg) — https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/gpu-ooms
Mina: can we reduce noise? these are usually transient during nightly jobs.
Sam: propose: keep P1 paging only if grouped by cluster and sustained >10m, else ticket. Add exponential backoff for repeat flares.
Raj: agreed. Also group by node_pool label so we don't page for a noisy job in a single pool.
Olivia: threshold suggestion: if >3 nodes with OOM within 15m across pool => page. Otherwise create ticket.
Mina: and set group_interval=5m, repeat_interval=30m in Alertmanager? Also silence during midnight maintenance window (02:00-03:00 UTC).
Sam: sketch of Alertmanager snippet:
```yaml
route:
  group_by: ['cluster','node_pool']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 30m
  routes:
    - match:
        severity: 'critical'
      continue: false
      receiver: 'pager'
    - match_re:
        severity: 'warning|info'
      receiver: 'ticket'
```
Raj: For Prometheus alert rule, use `for: 10m` + `count_over_time` on OOM metric. Example:
```yaml
- alert: GPUNodeOOMBurst
  expr: count_over_time(node_gpu_oom_total{job='node-exporter'}[15m]) > 3
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: critical
```
Olivia: We should also add a 'flap suppression' stage: a metric that tracks flaps per node and suppress pages if same node flapped >5 times in 1h (ticket only).
Mina: good call — reduces noisy redeploy cycles turning into pages.
Sam: ops: I'll open a PR with the config and add a Grafana panel for 'active_grouped_ooms' and a dashboard link in the PR.
Raj: can we also tie this into SLO dashboard so cost of pages is visible? paging has real ops cost.
Olivia: agreed — add a column 'pager_count' per cluster on SLO board.
Mina: action items:
- Sam: PR for Alertmanager + alert rules (due EOD)
- Olivia: update oncall runbook with new thresholds and maintenance quiet window
- Raj: add SLO metric mapping for pager cost
- Mina: verify historical noise reduction on staging (simulate bursts)
Sam: I'll also add a temporary mute rule for 02:00-03:00 UTC in silence manager (will post ID).

Olivia: thanks — if everyone OK, we'll deploy the rules tomorrow morning after the canary.
Raj: :thumbsup: deploying on Friday midday to avoid nightly jobs.
Mina: fine by me.
